description: This PHP source file implements a web service interface for Jira SOAP API integration and contains sample code for testing Jira issue creation and retrieval. It requires external configuration and communicates with Jira via a SOAP client, with numerous variables and commented code snippets illustrating different stages of interaction.

classes.name: jirasoapInterface
classes.description: A class to interface with Jira's SOAP API for issue management, including methods to connect, get issues, and add issues.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the SOAP interface is successfully connected to Jira.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Jira issue by its key.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue with provided summary and description.
